about.title: About Jiacheng Netting
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Netting Supplier Since 2005
about.description:
Shandong Jiacheng Chemical Fiber Products Co., Ltd. is a professional and leading manufacturer engaged in the production, research, development, and sales of high-performance warp knitting plastic nets since 2005. Our factory is located in Zhanjia Industrial Park, Shanghe County, Jinan City, Shandong Province, covering an area of approximately 20,000 square meters and equipped with modern production equipment and a top-notch technical team.

We focus on the production of plastic nets, including construction safety nets, hail nets, shade nets, shade sails, olive nets, bird nets, privacy screens, weed barrier fabric, wind barrier nets, aquaculture nets, and other warp knitting products. We have advanced production processes and technologies that support customization of plastic nets in various specifications, colors, and processes.

As an enterprise driven by innovation, we have a high-quality research and development team that continuously develops and manufactures new products to meet the ever-changing demands of our customers. We place great emphasis on product quality and technological innovation and have obtained BSCI and NFPA 701 certifications to ensure the safety and stability of product quality and production environment.

Our products have been exporting to North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Africa, and other countries, receiving high praise and recognition from customers. We will continue to improve product quality and service levels, providing customers with the highest quality products and services.

products.name: Safety Debris Netting
products.description: High density knitted polyethylene mesh netting (100% virgin HDPE). 1/8", 1/16" mesh hole opening. Fire-Retardant: Meets NFPA 701 Method II. Reinforced eyelet holes for fastening. Will not unravel when cut. Stays flexible in cold weather.
applications: Contains debris, dust and job site materials

products.name: Construction Safety Debris Netting
products.description: High density knitted polyethylene mesh netting (100% virgin HDPE). 1/4" mesh hole opening. Fire-Retardant: Meets NFPA 701 Method II. Edges are hemmed & reinforced for easy installation. Will not unravel when cut. Stays flexible in cold weather. Any color is available.
applications: Safety fence, barrier net, snow fence

products.name: Mesh Tarp
products.description: 1/16" mesh hole openings, made of 100% virgin HDPE. Brass grommets spaced apart every 2" on all edges. Double-stitch sides and all hems are re-enforced with polyester webbing. UV treated & protected. Fire-Retardant: Meets NFPA 701 Method 2. Will not unravel when cut. Stays flexible in cold weather.
applications: Privacy screen, visual barrier, wind barrier

products.name: Tape Shade Net
products.description: Made of 100% virgin HDPE. 30%-95% shade rate. Water-proof. UV treated. Width: 1m-12m (any length available). Color: Customize any color. Packaging: 1 roll/bag or 1 sheet/bag.
applications: Window, carport, porch and privacy screen

products.name: Shade Sail
products.description: Made of 100% virgin HDPE. Treated with a UV-stabilizing compound to prevent shade sails from drying out, tearing, and fading, significantly extending the lifespan. All edges are constructed with heavy-duty double-layered reinforced stitched seams, preventing frayed edges and out of shape. Each corner ends with a durable D-ring for easy hanging. Blocks 95% of harmful UV.

products.name: Anti Hail Net / Drape Net
products.description: 100% Virgin High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). Width: Maximum 12m. Length: Available in any length. Weight (GSM): 45g, 50g, 55g, 60g, 65g, 70g or as your request. Color: Black, Yellow, Green, Blue, Red, Orange or as your request. UV treated & protected. Comprehensive protection against hail for crops, fruit orchard or other things. Different mesh type options available.
applications: Comprehensive protection against hail for crops

products.name: Privacy Screen

applications: Block neighbor see through, protect personal privacy
Block surrounding noise and street view
Stops dogs from barking at neighbors

products.name: Anti-Bee Net
products.description: Made of 100% Virgin High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). Width: Maximum 12m. Length: Any length is available. UV-stabilized. Any color is available. products.name: Weed Barrier Fabric
products.description: Made of Heavy-Duty Professional Grade Polypropylene Material, chemical free, durable, sturdy and corrosion resistant. Keeps the soil healthy. Heavy duty weed blocker fabric is needle-punched to transmit water and air, preserving the soil moisture. Fabric allows air and water through, superior permeability to keep the soil nourished. Just water cleaning to be reusable.
